Entries.Text: Add a part for every character, or for every asset in a category, to the target map. The parts are laid out in a grid starting at the placement orb.
The map to create the parts in.
Load a map, or pick a loaded one, to create parts in.
What to create a part for.
Create an Enemy part for every character in the project's files.
Create an asset part for every asset of one category.
This game's MSB has no Enemy part, so characters can't be created this way.
This game's MSB has no asset or object part, so assets can't be created this way.
The asset category to create. For AEG assets, this is the AEG number (AEG099 for AEG099_001); for objects, it is the first two digits (o00 for o000100).
The category to create, with the number of assets in it.
No assets were found in the project's files.
Only create models that match the filter. Leave empty to create all of them.
How the parts are arranged. Each row runs along +X from the placement orb, and rows are added along +Z. When a grid is full, the next one starts next to it.
The number of parts in each row.
The number of rows in a grid. Further parts start a new grid next to the last.
{0} parts, in rows of {1}, up to {2} rows per grid: {3} grid(s).
The distances between the parts, in metres.
The distance between parts within a row.
The distance between one grid and the next.
Create the parts in the target map. This is one action, so a single undo removes them all.
The models to create parts for, in placement order.
